title: The ex vivo human translaminar autonomous system to study spaceflight associated neuro-ocular syndrome pathogenesis (Retina, RT-PCR and electroretinography)
organism: Homo sapiens (ex vivo human donor retina tissue)
assays: Real-Time PCR (RT-PCR) retinal stress gene profiling

protocols.experimental_factors: Treatment Pressure (ICP:IOP ratios 12:16 mmHg baseline vs 15:16 mmHg elevated intracranial pressure) & Optic Nerve Tilt

diagnostic_explanation: Cephalad fluid shift raises intracranial pressure (ICP) relative to intraocular pressure (IOP), flattening the posterior globe and inducing retinal edema (SANS).
